parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name of the device whose topology you want to delete.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID of the device whose topology you want to delete. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Overview** page or </ph></props>the ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device whose topology you want to delete belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
